findings.failure_path: when guard-merge-authorization.sh cannot run, UNSAFE_WHEN_MERGE_GUARD_DOWN_RE blocks only quote/escape characters and named VCS/network tools, so echoing a base64- or hex-encoded "git push"/"git merge" and piping it through base64 -d or xxd -r -p into sh matches nothing and is allowed, landing or sending changes without merge authorization and defeating the fail-closed-on-landing policy
findings.smallest_fix: also treat shell control operators (pipe, semicolon, ampersand, redirections, parens, newline) and shell/decoder/launcher words (sh, bash, base64, xxd, xargs, eval, env, make, ssh, scp, rsync) as unsafe — or fail closed for every run_command while the merge guard is down — and add deny tests for the encoded pipe-to-shell disguise

findings.failure_path: Contract defect: the rule tells maintainers adding or removing command hooks to sync AGY_HOOK_BINDINGS in hooks/agy-bridge.py, but the bridge defines the binding inventory as DISPATCH/bindings(); the named symbol does not exist, so the rule cannot be followed as written
findings.smallest_fix: rename it in AGENTS.md to the dispatch lists/bindings() (matching the nearer hooks/AGENTS.md wording) or add the alias in the bridge

concern_results.conclusion: Dispatch, payload mapping, deny-over-ask-over-allow aggregation, once-per-turn markers, patch-target loop and Stop loop prevention all trace correctly through the diff; the one defect found is the guard-down landing-command classifier (P1 below).

Bridge state is private (0700 dir, 0600 files, atomic replace), transcripts are bounded regular files with user text stripped, edit and delegation guards fail closed and unknown targets deny; however the "plainly harmless" filter used when the merge guard cannot run is bypassable with shell pipes, so a landing command can execute without merge authorization (P1).

Hook error/timeout, invalid JSON output, malformed tool calls, FIFO transcript, oversized transcript tail-read, missing cwd and run-lock contention each map to the declared safe answer (deny for guarded events, allow/empty/reminder-skip otherwise); residual gap is the P1 classifier, everything else degrades as documented.

The suite covers binding inventory parity with hooks.json, Claude-path decision parity, deny-beats-ask across patch targets, forged/swapped/partial evidence rejection, shadow privacy and removal, lock budget, traversal and FIFO bounds, and those tests would fail if the named behaviors regressed; it has no deny case for shell-control-operator disguises against the guard-down filter (folded into the P1 fix).

Scope matches the requester's words (first-class Antigravity host support, no push or PR); no unrequested switches, flags, gates or speculative abstractions; budgets and caps are tied to documented host timeouts; nothing to drop or split out.

In-packet claims (inventory tested one-to-one, fail-closed defaults, positional result pairing, tail-bounded reads) are test-backed; the register row's "keeps its decisions equal to the Claude path" rests on sampled differential parity rather than exhaustiveness, which is acceptable as a mechanism claim since the matrix exists and is cited.

The bridge satisfies hooks/AGENTS.md (dispatch lists as inventory, exactly one JSON object per event, declared failure defaults, validation command present); root AGENTS.md:49 names a symbol the code does not define (P2 Contract defect).

challenge_focus: Delta review after the adversarial challenge. The npm Antigravity adapter was narrowed (no snapshots: install from the bundled plugin, receipt of file hashes, temporary verified backup for update rollback, journal records only that an operation was in flight, shared lock with scripts/install-antigravity.sh). The checkout installer now records a full file-hash inventory and refreshes only on an exact match. The bridge stopped lexical path collapsing, uses workspacePaths only when it is a single absolute directory, allows only plainly harmless commands when the merge guard cannot run, checks every patch target before returning ask, and bounds its run-lock wait inside the event deadline. Check these fixes for regressions and remaining data-loss or bypass paths. Requester asked: first-class Antigravity host support, no push or PR.
